## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `fa628d0b3602a4df059add483084b23b826c85f9`
Card: #19146 · PR #19379 (one commit; base `ada701220b`, 2 files, +22 / −10) · isolated adversarial review, measured in a detached worktree at the head, every exit code captured before any pipe.

### ① Derived judgments

- Surface, derived: `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 19379` → 2 paths three-dot, `GOVERNED — Tier S`, exit 3, size +22/−10 under the 5,000 line; `landing-operations.md` hits the `claude-tree` row, `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` is not on the register. Tier claim in the PR body: CORRECT.
- Register behaviour probed on real paths (`--test`, one path each): `.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout.sh`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, `.claude/README.md` → Tier S; `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/adr/**`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` → Tier H; `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` + `AGENTS.md` together → Tier H (ALL-not-ANY, `landingTierOf`, empty answers H); `.claudeX/x.md`, `docs/adrs/x.md`, `scripts/pm/*.mjs` → not governed.
- Queue-guard docblock (:286–:307) against that behaviour: CORRECT. 「widened … to the WHOLE of `.claude/**` — Tier S … leaving Tier H as exactly the register's other rows」 matches the six-row register (`.claude/**` the sole `GOVERNED_TIER_S` row); 「this leg asks `governedTierFor`」 is true (imported :513, drives every entry's tier at :972); 「a governed diff whose governed paths are ALL Tier S」 keeps the quantifier; the concluding sentence is now true.
- The quoted 2026-09-13 ruling: PRESERVED. Lines 266–278 are byte-identical between merge-base and head (diff exit 0); the quote is untranslated and the new paragraph marks it 「⭐ SUPERSEDED 2026-09-18 (#19133 …)」 naming the ruling and its amendment. The amendment is quoted in the file's existing short form 「我觉得这些我也没必要确认」 (:668–:670, landed by #19144); the full chat line on #19133 continues 「:.claude/settings.json、.claude/hooks/**」 — consistent with landed text, not charged to this PR.
- Behaviour: UNCHANGED, proven. All 28 changed lines in the `.mjs` are ` *` docblock lines; the module's AST with comments and positions stripped is identical at merge-base and head (acorn). `GOVERNED_SURFACES`, `GOVERNED_TIER_H/S`, `governedTierFor`, `landingTierOf` live in `check-governed-merges.mjs`, which is not in the diff; the pin `skills-agents-and-the-fact-layer-are-Tier-S` stands at :3896. Self-tests at the head: `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` exit 0, 296 cases; `check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test` exit 0, 435 assertions; `check-half-states.mjs --self-test` exit 0, 5092; `check-clause2-carriers.mjs --self-test` exit 0, 1071.
- `landing-operations.md:27` — DEFECT (nearly right is wrong on a rules line). The predecessor line began 「受管路径全在 … 者」, the card's prescribed wording for this item begins 「受管路径全在 `.claude/**` 者 Tier S」, and the sibling `contract-review.md:46` still reads 「受管路径全在 Tier S 面(`.claude/**`)者」. The new line 「Tier S(`.claude/**` 全树)者」 names the SURFACE and drops the PR-level ALL quantifier, so lines 27/28 now partition surfaces, not PRs: a mixed diff (`.claude/**` + `AGENTS.md`, Tier H by the register) has two applicable lines and no tiebreak on this page. The line is 93 B; 「- 受管路径全在 `.claude/**` 者 Tier S:席内达档复核过落地前检三条即转正式入队。」 measures 105 B, inside the 120 B cap, line count 69 unchanged. Required: restore the quantifier.
- `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs:4442–4443` — DEFECT, same file, same superseded boundary, LIVE. The `--self-test` success line, printed on every run (it is in this review's own capture), still says 「the #18020 references TIER: a governed diff whose governed paths all lie under the one ruled prefix lands on the skills seat's review of record」, while the battery above it (:3949–:3950) asserts `the-old-references-boundary-is-GONE`. Landed 2026-09-13 in #18036, untouched by #19144, present at merge-base and head. The PR body claims to have removed this file's self-contradiction; one instance remains and it is the one seats read (the "296 cases pass" line). Required: re-key the population in that string to Tier S / the register's `.claude/**` row since #19133 (history may stay, as in the docblock). No expected value moves.
- `landing-operations.md:28`: 「Tier H(其余受管面)者:四件套留 draft 等人批…」 is CORRECT against the register (every non-`.claude/**` row is H) and against PD #14; 120 B, at the cap, 69/69, ratchet exit 0. Line 26's 「照规则层」 and line 28's 「Tier H」 now mix vocabularies on one page; SKILL.md:625 defines them as synonyms — noted, no action.
- Gates at the head: skill-line-ratchet exit 0 (69/69), skill-id-lint exit 0 (27 clean), governed-prose exit 0 (6/6), skill-frame-sync exit 0, eslint exit 0, `node --check` exit 0. CI on the head: 38 check-runs, 24 success / 14 skipped / 0 failed; the seven required contexts are success except `Build Core` and `Temporal Conformance`, expected skips for a docs-only diff.

### ② Semver level

None. Docs-only rules repair: no `packages/*` path, and neither `.claude/**` nor `scripts/pm/**` ships in any released package's `files[]`. `skip-changeset` is the correct label for this file list, and `Clause-②: no` is the correct declaration (no contract surface touched) — which the missing claim comment (③) must carry.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Third carrier (H43), verified independently: at this head the H43 row spans `check-half-states.mjs:10023–:10259` (the brief's ≈9940–10110 is off at this base). Anchored counts over that span: `\btier\b` 0, `\bTier\b` 0, `\bgovernedTierFor\b` 0, `\blandingTier\w*\b` 0, `\bGOVERNED_TIER_[HS]\b` 0, `\bGOVERNED_APPROVERS\b` 5, `\bGOVERNED_SURFACES\b` 2, `\bgovernedPathsIn\b` 3. Radius control, whole 36,335-line file: `tier` 83, `Tier` 55 (e.g. the `Tier:` triage line at :15948), `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` 7, `governedTierFor` 0 — the file never imports the tier function at all. The row loads `governedPathsIn` and `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` lazily (:10155–:10156), decides 「asked NOBODY」 from approvers alone, prescribes a review request / assign fallback, and prints 「the queue guard still refuses an unapproved governed enqueue」 — falsified for Tier S by PR #19351 (all-`.claude/**` plus `check-half-states.mjs`, 0 reviews, merged `231283a6e2` 2026-09-20T14:28Z on a record). The claim on the card is confirmed. H48 (:11304–:11509) is tier-blind by the same instrument (0 tier tokens, 8× 维护者速读) and is the card's listed item 3.
- RULING on completeness: this PR is NOT incomplete for lacking H43, and leaving it to the card is correct — H43 is missing logic, not a spelling: it needs a lazy `governedTierFor` load in a file that travels to sibling repos (the row's own docblock is why the import must be lazy) plus a self-test case under `pnpm check:pm-half-states`, a behaviour change in a non-governed instrument that does not belong under this docs-only Tier S record; H48 is the same change class in the same file, so H43 rides with H48 in one half-states PR. Two obligations follow: the card body must enumerate H43 as an item (today it lives only in comment 5750573385), and this PR's "On the card" paragraph must list H43 among the items it does not touch (it lists only os-dev.md, H48, SKILL.md:608).
- Residual superseded-boundary statements after this PR (sweep by meaning over tracked files, not by the `references/` token): LIVE — `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:286–:287` (card item 1), `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:608` 「⛔ 无事实层例外」 (card addendum, vocabulary only, the rule stays true), `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs:4442–:4443` (①, required here). NAMING only, not boundary claims — the leg is still called "the references tier" at queue-guard :268 (heading), :358, :442, :452, :646, :736 and in code comments :1420/:1546/:2261/:2470/:2560, and at `check-clause2-carriers.mjs:8635`; a tidy is optional and may ride the revision. Current text that cites the old boundary as history: `check-governed-merges.mjs:321`, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:327`, `check-clause2-carriers.mjs:8647`, and `规则层` at `landing-operations:26`, `lanes/skills.md:17`, `core-rules:122`, `contract-review:46`, `SKILL.md:607/:625` — fine.
- Landing blocker independent of this verdict: card #19146 carries NO `Claim:` comment naming branch `claude/pm-superseded-references-tier`, and the PR body carries no `Clause-②` line. `check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 19379` reads exit 4 on the declaration limb for that reason alone (`pair.1.claim.selected: none`), so even a PASS record could not meet the Tier S predicate (`--pair` at 0). The owning seat posts the claim with `Clause-②: no` on the card before re-recording; the card stays `pm:queue`, unassigned, per AGENTS.md claim discipline.
- Identity: the PR footer carries this seat's session URL; `Implemented-by` is the `mode:subagent` dev's branch per `contract-review.md:35`, and :37 makes a `mode:subagent` in-seat review by design. This record was produced by an isolated subagent under `scratchpad/pr-19379/` fed the card, the rulings and the PR only (:33–:34); the pair reads branch vs session, not SELF-REVIEW.
- The brief's comment id `5750553107` is a 404; the H43 finding on the card is comment `5750573385`. Recorded so no later reader cites the wrong id.
- Ruling text verified on #19133 directly: 「同意改规则。」 (body) and the amendment 「我觉得这些我也没必要确认:.claude/settings.json、.claude/hooks/**」 (comment 5736867336); blockers #19144, #19021, #19033 all merged, so `landing-operations.md:26` (#19033) is on the base and item 2 is unblocked.
- Nothing in this review modified the PR, its branch, labels or state; no approval, no enqueue.

Implemented-by: `claude/pm-superseded-references-tier`
Reviewed-by: `session_01AmH9bKvGoLjiY86Q4Z3og2`

**VERDICT: FAIL**
